name.description: The name of the stakeholder organization or individual.

category.description: The category of the stakeholder (Regulator, Supplier, Consumer, Competitor, Partner, Influencer, Internal).

role.description: Brief description of the stakeholder's role or function.

hierarchy_level.description: Level in the ecosystem hierarchy (Macro, Meso, Micro).

stakeholders.description: List of stakeholders identified in the text.

Label.description: The descriptive name for the factor.

Type.description: Classification type (e.g., Indirect Driver, Exogenous Driver, Outcome, Direct Driver).

Description.description: A detailed description of the factor including stakeholder information.

factors.description: List of factors identified in the text.

id.description: A unique identifier for the pain point (e.g., PP-001).

category.description: The category of the pain point (e.g., Healthcare Access, Financial Barriers).

description.description: A brief description of the pain point.

affected_stakeholders.description: List of stakeholder names that experience or are affected by this pain point.

causing_stakeholders.description: List of stakeholder names that cause or contribute to this pain point (optional).

stakeholder_impact.description: Detailed impact description for each affected stakeholder

additionalProperties.description: Description of how this pain point specifically affects the named stakeholder

confidence.description: Confidence score (0-100%) for this pain point identification.

hierarchy_level.description: Level in the ecosystem hierarchy (Macro, Meso, Micro).

severity.description: Severity level of the pain point based on text evidence.

pain_points.description: List of pain points identified in the text, with explicit stakeholder relationships.

id.description: A unique identifier for the relationship (e.g., REL-001).

source_stakeholder.description: The name of the source stakeholder in the relationship.

target_stakeholder.description: The name of the target stakeholder in the relationship.

relationship_type.description: The primary type of relationship (e.g., Regulatory, Collaborative, Competitive, Transactional, Hierarchical, Informational).

relationship_subtype.description: The specific subtype of relationship (e.g., Oversight, Partnership, Rivalry, Service Provision, Reporting, Advisory).

direction.description: The direction of the relationship (Bidirectional, Unidirectional_Source_to_Target, Unidirectional_Target_to_Source).

strength.description: The strength of the relationship (0-100%), based on frequency of interaction or importance mentioned in text.

justification.description: Detailed justification for this relationship based on evidence from the text, including specific quotes or references.

confidence.description: Confidence score (0-100%) for this relationship identification.

relationships.description: List of relationships between stakeholders identified in the text.
